translations.web: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
translations.bsb: The woman said to Him, “Sir, give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
translations.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
translations.asv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come all the way hither to draw.
